rationale: C10 plausibly supplied a material structural template: it explains the need for review, establishes a presidential board, defines the field and principal focus of its study, directs reporting to the President, and closes by anticipating full cooperation. The child follows the same compact administrative sequence for foreign-intelligence review. C03 and C12 contain related board/committee study-and-report machinery, but their sequences and purposes are less closely aligned. The limited shared wording is largely conventional, so the relationship is structural rather than a strong literal-language match.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am constituting a Board of Consultants to review periodically the foreign intelligence activities of this Government, and to report their findings' to me.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am therefore establishing by Executive order a temporary Communications Policy Board of 5 members to study and to make recommendations to me
shared_material.explanation: Both establish a presidential review board and immediately define its study and reporting function.

shared_material.child_excerpt: While the review would concern itself with the sum total of these activities, it would be expected that major attention would be concentrated upon the work of the Central Intelligence Agency.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Executive order establishing this Board states that the Board shall study the present and potential use of radio and wire communications facilities... I feel that the problem of radio frequencies will be one of the most important areas for the Board's investigations.
shared_material.explanation: Both give the board a broad field of review and then identify the principal area on which attention should concentrate.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I know that you will afford the Board of Consultants the fullest cooperation in its work.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am sure that you will receive the full cooperation and assistance of all parties concerned.
shared_material.explanation: Both conclude the board's mandate by calling for full cooperation, reinforcing the parallel operative structure despite the conventional wording.
